implementation_strategy: Use the registered hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter: one hosted-model generation call (gpt-5-mini) per candidate (464 total). Deterministic text→canonical parser transforms generated text to verified-config AST; deterministic verifier runs on identical canonical AST. Baseline: always execute sandbox dry-run on canonical AST. Guarded: run verifier; only if verifier returns 'pass' execute guarded sandbox dry-run; otherwise record blocked_by_verifier. All sandbox dry-runs executed on CPU-based resettable emulator snapshots. Up to 2 automated retries for transient generation/parser/sandbox failures; verifier unit-tests run before main execution and on any verifier binary update. All steps fully automated; no human labour, no local GPU, no Kubernetes, no external partners, and all artifacts logged and hashed.
task_manifest_strategy: Enumerate and publish a confirmatory task bank of 464 public synthetic intent items (ACL, routing, NAT, service-exposure) derived from preregistered public corpora. Each entry is a paired unit (same generated candidate evaluated baseline and guarded). Manifest entries hashed and included in artifact bundle.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Deterministic parser (text→canonical JSON AST) with automated round-trip checks (parse→render→re-parse equality); verifier-input serializer validated against JSON Schema; sandbox wrapper generator produces emulator inputs. All transformations unit-tested; failures auto-excluded per preregistration rules.
execution_batches: batch-1: Generate 464 candidates via gpt-5-mini (one call per candidate). For each candidate: parse→canonicalize; run baseline sandbox dry-run; run deterministic verifier; if verifier passes then execute guarded sandbox dry-run; log artifacts. Batches parallelized on isolated CPU sandbox instances, preserving emulator snapshot isolation.
randomisation_plan: Paired fixed design: no between-condition randomisation. Prompt-variation allocation predetermined: two prompt-variations split deterministically across task indices (232 per prompt-variation). Allocation logged and hashed.
caching_plan: Cache parser binaries, JSON Schemas, verifier rule-set snapshots, emulator snapshot images and pre-warmed sandbox instances. Do not cache hosted model responses beyond storing logged artifact responses; cache invalidated on verifier unit-test regression.
failure_recovery_plan: Automated retry up to 2 attempts for transient generation/parser/sandbox failures. Contaminated sandbox runs auto-retried up to 2 times; if contamination persists mark as 'contamination-exclusion' and exclude. Verifier unit-test failure triggers automated halt, archival of verifier binary and logs, and automated regression reinstall before resume. All exclusions logged with deterministic codes.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: fields per episode include task_id, model_call_id, generated_text, canonical_ast, verifier_decision, baseline_sandbox_result_harmful:boolean, guarded_sandbox_result_harmful:boolean_or_blocked, blocked_by_verifier:boolean, harm_category:string|null, exclusion_code:string|null, artifact_hashes (SHA256).
estimated_compute_notes: Totals: 464 hosted-model generation calls (one per candidate). Maximum model-call budget = task_count * 2 = 464*2 = 928 (one generation + at most one repair/extra model call per task) per adapter contract; planned estimated_model_calls=464 (no repair calls expected in nominal flow). Expected sandbox dry-run executions: baseline 464 + expected guarded passes ≈ pass_fraction*464 (conservative pass_fraction=0.5 → expected guarded ≈232) ⇒ expected total sandbox runs ≈696. All verifier and sandbox runs CPU-executable; wall-clock fits within maximum_wall_clock_days=7 with parallel CPU sandbox instances. All totals derived arithmetically from task_count and adapter per-task call limits; model call totals do not exceed adapter or capability manifest maximums.
